stem: ![](asset:P000329-stem-1)Two blocks are connected by a string as shown in the diagram. The upper block is hung by another string. A force F applied on the upper string produces an acceleration of $2\ m/s^{2}$ in the upward direction in both the blocks. If T and $T'$ be the tensions in the two parts of the string, then find its values?

assets.alt: A 2 kg block with a 4 kg block hanging below it: the string between them has tension T, and the string above the 2 kg block has tension T′ and is pulled upwards.
